items.source: ex - the exception that got thrown during handler execution
items.translation: ex - 在处理器执行期间抛出的异常

items.source:
If no handler predicate, nor handlers, nor handler classes are set,
the exception resolver applies to all handlers.
items.translation: 如果没有设置处理器谓词、处理器或处理器类，异常解析器将应用于所有处理器。

items.source: response - current HTTP response
items.translation: response - 当前 HTTP 响应

items.source: Whether there are any handler mappings registered via setMappedHandlers(Set), setMappedHandlerClasses(Class[]), or setMappedHandlerPredicate(Predicate).
items.translation: 是否已通过 `setMappedHandlers(Set)`、`setMappedHandlerClasses(Class[])` 或 `setMappedHandlerPredicate(Predicate)` 注册了任何处理器映射。

items.source: Alternative to setMappedHandlerClasses(Class[]).
items.translation: `setMappedHandlerClasses(Class[])` 的替代方案。

items.source: Return the configured mapped handler classes.
items.translation: 返回configured映射的处理程序类。

items.source: request - current HTTP request
items.translation: request - 当前 HTTP 请求

items.source: Supports mapped handlers and handler classes that the resolver should be applied to and implements the Ordered interface.
items.translation: 支持映射的处理器和处理器类，解析器应应用于这些对象，并实现了Ordered接口。

items.source: By default there is no warn logging although subclasses like DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver can change that default. Specify this setting to activate warn logging into a specific category. Alternatively, override the logException(Exception, HttpServletRequest) method for custom logging.
items.translation: 默认情况下没有警告日志，尽管像DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver这样的子类可以更改此默认设置。指定此设置以激活特定类别的警告日志。或者，重写logException(Exception, HttpServletRequest)方法以实现自定义日志记录。

items.source: The default implementation checks against the configured handlerPredicate handlers and handler classes, if any.
items.translation: 默认实现会检查配置的`handlerPredicate`、`handlers` 和 `handler classes`（如果有的话）。

items.source: Default is false. Switch this to true in order to automatically generate HTTP response headers that suppress response caching.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`。将其切换为 `true` 以自动生成抑制响应缓存的 HTTP 响应头。

items.source: Calls buildLogMessage(Exception, HttpServletRequest) in order to determine the concrete message to log.
items.translation: 调用buildLogMessage(Exception, HttpServletRequest)以确定要记录的具体消息。

items.source: The default implementation prevents the response from being cached, if the "preventResponseCaching" property has been set to "true".
items.translation: 默认实现会阻止响应被缓存，如果已设置 `"preventResponseCaching"` 属性为 `"true"`。

items.source: May be overridden in subclasses, in order to apply specific exception checks. Note that this template method will be invoked after checking whether this resolver applies ("mappedHandlers" etc), so an implementation may simply proceed with its actual exception handling.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写，以应用特定的异常检查。请注意，此模板方法将在检查此解析器是否适用（如"mappedHandlers"等）之后被调用，因此实现可以直接进行实际的异常处理。

items.source: Check whether this resolver is supposed to apply (i.e. if the supplied handler matches any of the configured handlers or handler classes), and then delegate to the doResolveException(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Object, Exception) template method.
items.translation: 检查此解析器是否应该应用（即，如果提供的处理器匹配任何配置的处理器或处理器类），然后委托给doResolveException(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Object, Exception)模板方法。

items.source: Log the given exception at warn level, provided that warn logging has been activated through the "warnLogCategory" property.
items.translation: 在通过 `"warnLogCategory"` 属性激活了 warn 日志的情况下，以 warn 级别记录给定的异常。

items.source: Prevents the response from being cached, through setting corresponding HTTP Cache-Control: no-store header.
items.translation: 通过设置相应的 HTTP `Cache-Control: no-store` 响应头，防止响应被缓存。

items.source: Logger available to subclasses.
items.translation: 可供子类使用的 Logger。

items.source: Build a log message for the given exception, occurred during processing the given request.
items.translation: 为给定请求处理期间发生的给定异常构建日志消息。

items.source: resolveException in interface HandlerExceptionResolver
items.translation: `resolveException` 接口 `HandlerExceptionResolver` 中

items.source: a corresponding ModelAndView to forward to, or null for default processing in the resolution chain
items.translation: 一个用于转发的对应 `ModelAndView`，或为解析链中的默认处理而设置的 `null`。

items.source: request - current HTTP request (useful for obtaining metadata)
items.translation: request - 当前 HTTP 请求（可用于获取元数据）

items.source:
whether this resolved should proceed with resolving the exception
for the given request and handler
items.translation: 是否应继续针对给定请求和处理器解析该异常

items.source: the log message to use
items.translation: 要使用的日志消息

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。

items.source: Description copied from interface: Ordered
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：Ordered

items.source: Actually resolve the given exception that got thrown during handler execution, returning a ModelAndView that represents a specific error page if appropriate.
items.translation: 实际上解决在处理器执行期间抛出的给定异常，如果适当的话，返回一个代表特定错误页面的 ModelAndView。

items.source: Use a Predicate to determine which handlers this exception resolver applies to, including when the request was not mapped in which case the handler is null.
items.translation: 使用一个 `Predicate` 来确定此异常解析器适用于哪些处理器，包括请求未映射的情况（此时处理器为 `null`）。

items.source: Get the order value of this object.
items.translation: 获取该对象的订单值。

items.source: Prepare the response for the exceptional case.
items.translation: 请为异常情况准备响应。

items.source: Specify the set of classes that this exception resolver should apply to.
items.translation: 指定此异常解析器应适用的类集。

items.source: Specify the set of handlers that this exception resolver should apply to.
items.translation: 指定此异常解析器应适用的处理器集。

items.source:
Specify whether to prevent HTTP response caching for any view resolved
by this exception resolver.
items.translation: 指定是否阻止此异常解析器解析的任何视图的 HTTP 响应缓存。

items.source: Set the log category for warn logging.
items.translation: 设置 warn 日志的日志类别。

items.source: Check whether this resolver is supposed to apply to the given handler.
items.translation: 检查该解析器是否应应用于给定的处理器。
